notes.title: Traditional Chinese
notes.notes:
Snowball Saves Summer has been translated into Traditional Chinese! Just like with the other translations, you can change your language via the settings menu at any time. This patch also fixes a few other bugs found after the previous update.

To celebrate, we're running a 30% discount from Black Friday to Cyber Monday!

Have fun!

notes.title: Turkish, German, and Brazilian Portuguese
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33569006/d2514636a175deb283b4c637d6d7a1c6dac2af81.jpg[/img]

Just in time for the Halloween Sale, we've added three new languages to the game: Turkish, German, and Brazilian Portuguese. You can select the language from the settings menu in-game.

This patch also includes several minor bug fixes. Enjoy, and have a happy Halloween!
